# Build on Monark

For developers: connect your own code to a Monark instance, or extend Monark itself. New to the codebase? Start with [Set up a development environment](../get-started/set-up-a-development-environment.md).

- [Public API](public-api/_index.md): read and write your organization's data models and records over REST with an API key.
- [Webhooks](webhooks/_index.md): receive Monark's event deliveries in your own service and verify them.
- [Agents and MCP](agents-and-mcp/_index.md): give an AI agent or OpenAPI tool access, limited to what its key can do.
- [Extend Monark](extend/_index.md): add modules, permissions, events, notifications, flags, schema, tests, search sources, automation nodes, API endpoints and assistant tools.
